title: 挂播？挂在哪儿？
author: 林爱丽
common: A polished 16:9 single-shot anime minidrama, with identical expressive chibi Tan Jianci: neat dark hair, black jacket, gentle brown eyes; and exact yellow T Hoo Hoo flame mascot: blue oval eyes, pink cheeks, tiny arms, white shoes. The reference image is a CHARACTER STYLE BOARD only: NO visible storyboard panels, grid, speech bubbles, subtitles, watermarks or invented user interface. Soft cinematic pink-and-amber room lighting, expressive smooth motion, warm humor, native clear Mandarin speech, male voice for chibi idol, high sweet voice for T Hoo Hoo, mouth moves only while speaking. No copied music tracks, fake ranking numbers, face distortion or duplicated arms.

scenes.title: 榜单告急
scenes.sub: T Hoo Hoo：哎呀！由你榜日榜掉出前十啦！
scenes.prompt: A worried Tan Jianci sits behind a tablet, T Hoo Hoo notices a chart and gasps wide-eyed. The tablet is mostly blank, no ranking digits. T Hoo Hoo says: 哎呀！由你榜日榜掉出前十啦！. Tan Jianci gently raises one eyebrow.

scenes.title: 字面理解
scenes.sub: T Hoo Hoo：挂播？我挂好了！
scenes.prompt: Tiny yellow T Hoo Hoo drags a small coat hanger and literally hangs a smartphone on the hanger at the wall, grinning with pride. The anime man stares in surprise. T Hoo Hoo says: 挂播？我挂好了！. Comedic squeak as the coat hanger wobbles.

scenes.title: 无语三秒
scenes.sub: 动漫大哥：我是说听歌，不是把手机挂起来！
scenes.prompt: The anime idol gives a long funny deadpan silent reaction, then gently removes the smartphone from the hanger. He says: 我是说听歌，不是把手机挂起来！. Yellow mascot's eyes blink in embarrassment, then lights up.

scenes.title: 正确示范
scenes.sub: 动漫大哥：打开QQ音乐，搜《Trouble In My DMs》，点击播放。
scenes.prompt: The anime idol shows T Hoo Hoo a phone with simple music-player icons, pointing to a search icon and a play icon. Keep screen uncluttered without fabricated UI. He says: 打开QQ音乐，搜 Trouble In My DMs，点击播放。 The mascot nods seriously.

scenes.title: 快乐听歌
scenes.sub: T Hoo Hoo：原来边做事，也能继续听歌！
scenes.prompt: Three yellow T Hoo Hoo mascots doing calm hobbies, reading, drawing, organizing a table while enjoying music, one wears soft headphones, no chaotic dancing. Main mascot says: 原来边做事，也能继续听歌！ Smiling chibi idol watching.

scenes.title: 大声召集
scenes.sub: T Hoo Hoo：挂播！挂播！挂播！ 大哥：量力支持，谢谢！
scenes.prompt: Four cute yellow T Hoo Hoo mascots wave glow sticks and one holds a pink megaphone, while anime Tan Jianci smiles. Mascot shouts distinctly three times: 挂播！挂播！挂播！ He warmly replies: 量力支持，谢谢！ Joyful original confetti, final upbeat pose, keep lower third clear.
